work.description: Brief XCIV (address LF16116–16120; the address line LF16117 begins with a literal OCR mark *) names Giuseppe Angelo Fazio, bishop-elect of Tipasa, visitor of the Capuchin missions; LF16176 → LF16185 across own provenance LF16179 and page-111 running title LF16182; complete 13 May 1836 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF16123–16123; the source closing at LF16196–16199 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum sub an- nulo piscatoris die decima tertia maii millesimo Octingentesimo trigesimo sexto, pontificatus No- stri anno sexto. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
